notes: Labels and composition aliases identify existing accepted facts. They never supply missing weapons or guess physical bearers.
Printed alternative modes and ranged/melee profiles belonging to one named weapon selection share one physical quantity.

Generic drone definitions retain one canonical owner. Selected inventory identities remain exact own-unit source occurrences with source captions; this metadata does not duplicate generic drone gameplay facts.

Drone tokens are equipment, not additional MODEL rows. Known canonical provided-weapon identity and quantity remain UNIT-level inventory when the MODEL bearer is unknown; MODEL-dependent gameplay effects require a confirmed physical MODEL recipient.
Unknown canonical selections remain NEEDS_BINDINGS. Legends and Crucible vocabulary not present among the 43 accepted current Datasheets is not enrolled.
No equipment eligibility, caps, mutual exclusion or replacement-legality validation is introduced. Source occurrences provide identity/provenance only.
